bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears remain uncertain about their starting quarterback for Monday night's home game against the Eagles, as the starting quarterback won't be determined until later in the week, though coach Ben Johnson is comfortable with every option . Backup Case Keenum appears to be the frontrunner if Caleb Williams can't go, with OC Press Taylor expressing confidence that "I don't think anybody has any doubt he'll be ready for the moment" regarding Keenum stepping in.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions released their Week 3 injury report ahead of Sunday's game against the New York Jets, revealing official injury designations for their contest at Ford Field, including news that TE Mason Taylor, S Minkah Fitzpatrick and LB Kiko Mauigoa won't play for the Jets . Meanwhile, coming off a rough Week 2 loss to Buffalo, Detroit got a positive update as rookie right tackle Blake Miller returned to practice and is on track to play Sunday , giving the Lions a boost as they look to bounce back against New York.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Green Bay Packers were routed 35-14 by the Atlanta Falcons in a disastrous Thursday night home opener at Lambeau Field, drawing boos from fans and sharp criticism as the team struggled with missed tackles and an ineffective run game. Head coach Matt LaFleur addressed the miserable home-opener loss, while receiver Christian Watson admitted the team right now is 'not good enough,' as the Packers now face pressure to bounce back and figure out what went wrong on both sides of the ball.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: Kyler Murray has cleared the concussion protocol and is set to start at quarterback for the 2-0 Vikings in their Week 3 matchup against the Buccaneers, taking back the job from Carson Wentz who filled in over the past two games. Running back Aaron Jones, who had been dealing with a knee issue, returned to full practice and is expected to play Sunday as Minnesota looks to build on its surprising undefeated start.
